description: Opt-in read-only P2:CE Workshop content mounted ahead of retail Portal 2 by tools/quality/stage_portal2_runtime.py --workshop (./play_p2 --workshop). Earlier packs win. Only paths under 'include' are taken; maps, scripts and VScripts the packs also ship are never mounted. A model is taken whole (mdl/vvd/vtx/phy) from the first pack that ships any of its files. Nothing here is redistributed; the bytes stay in the user's Steam installation. The stager refuses a selected collision model that is not VPHY version 0x0100.
decision: User direction 2026-10-07: enable the Tier 1 packs of the workshop review except November Doors.

packs.title: GLaDOS - The Lab (Model Port) - V2
packs.why: The Lab's GLaDOS as glados_animation.mdl with high-resolution VertexLitGeneric materials. Its materials reuse retail names (glados_head, glados_chest, glados_hips, glados_cables, glados_selfillum) that 13 retail models share with other UV layouts, so they move to models/npcs/glalab/ and only this model uses them.

drop_keys.reason: misspelled $selfillumtint: VertexLitGeneric declares no such parameter, so Source never reads it; the render core refuses unknown keys by name and would drop GLaDOS's head (2026-10-07)

packs.title: Retextured PBR Portal Gun
packs.why: 2K PBR portal gun (chosen over Bonnie's 3519554320): VTF 7.6 BC7 textures read through texturecontainer vtf_decompress; its P2:CE PBR materials draw on the core's pbr point (render.lab.pbr-compat)

packs.title: Higher Resolution Indicator Lights
packs.why: High-resolution indicator decals under new names; they replace no retail material until a mapping selects them

not_mounted.title: Aperture Desk Job Weighted Storage Cubes
not_mounted.reason: every model's collision is VPHY 0x0101 (P2:CE), which neither vphysics provider reads; its materials serve only those models

not_mounted.title: Ending: Enhanced (V1.00)
not_mounted.reason: its PBR materials need textures from ApertureVR (3506356222, pbr/aperturevr/black_wall_metal) and P2:CE base content, which this mount does not supply

not_mounted.title: Core Transfer: Re-Enhanced (V1.00)
not_mounted.reason: its PBR materials need textures from ApertureVR (pbr/aperturevr/plastic_wall) and P2:CE base content (pbr/metal/black_tiles_128)

not_mounted.title: Glowing Vacuum Tubes
not_mounted.reason: its vacum_pipe.vmt replaces retail's with an animated, self-illuminated VertexLitGeneric material that the render core drops, so retail vacuum pipes vanish (158 draws dropped in sp_a2_laser_intro, 2026-10-07)
